gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-001 identifies the same Gaussian-moments covariance ODE defect: the second drift factor must be transposed, yielding Sigma_t C_{*,t}^{-1}P_t rather than Sigma_t P_t C_{*,t}^{-1}. It also correctly recognizes that noncommutation makes the stated right-hand side nonsymmetric and supplies the corresponding correction.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: Both entries diagnose the invalid use of the untransposed drift matrix in the covariance evolution. The resulting cross-term has the wrong matrix order and can fail symmetry when the preconditioner and P_t do not commute.

component_coverage.gold_component: The covariance identity and resulting ODE use the wrong-order second drift factor, omitting the transpose and thereby producing a potentially nonsymmetric covariance derivative in the noncommuting case.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction states the standard covariance formula F Sigma + Sigma F^T, explicitly contrasts the erroneous Sigma_t P_t C^{-1} term with the required Sigma_t C^{-1}P_t term, notes the nonsymmetry under noncommutation, and gives the transpose-based repair.
